Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Mahajan
 Order

The present petition is filed by the petitioners seeking quashing of FIR No. 316/2021 dated 06.07.2021, registered at police station Mohan Garden for the offences under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 including the proceedings emanating therefrom, on the grounds of settlement.
3. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.

4. Mr. Gaurav Malhotra, learned counsel accepts notice on behalf of Respondent No. 2.
5.
Replies, if any, be filed before the next date of hearing.

6. List on 07.11.2025.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J SEPTEMBER 25, 2025/DU
